preconditions.description: The number of houses N is greater than 1 and less than or equal to 100,000.
The number of roads is exactly N-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N and 1 <= b <= N and a != b for a, b in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct houses, each numbered between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: total_length == sum(shortest_paths[i][v_i - 1] for i, v_i in enumerate(assignment, 1))
postconditions.description: The total length is the sum of the shortest paths from each house i to the new house v_i.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= N and v_i != i for i, v_i in enumerate(assignment, 1))
postconditions.description: Each villager moves to a distinct house v_i, different from their original house i.
All new house assignments are distinct.
The total length is the smallest possible total length of the shortest paths.
